items.summary: fix(mcp): finish session termination without waiting on body cancellation (#141289) ## What Problem This Solves Fixes an issue where operators probing an MCP server with `openclaw mcp doctor --probe --json` encounter delayed local cleanup and uncertain cleanup when the server accepts session termination but response-body cancellation never settles. ## Why This Change Was Made Start body cancellation as best-effort work and consume its rejection so the existing termination owner can validate the DELETE response and finish closing the transport and client. Preserve the five-second DELETE signal, configured fetch owner, negotiated session identity, successful-status/405 handling, duplicate-termination guard, and outer cleanup deadlines. The regression uses HTTP 200 both on the wire and in the injected response. It covers pending/rejecting cancellation, accepted 405, and rejected status accounting. Preserves @hugenshen's contribution and ancestry. ## User Impact MCP cleanup finishes promptly after accepted termination even if body cancellation stalls or rejects. Failed DELETE responses still report uncertain cleanup, and failed initialization remains a visible probe failure. ## Evidence Validated baseline `1066fad578df56c24f2c3a2e3e7106786f0eda66` and candidate `a592e8df67575da489d8c5265e0429f4d0a559ec`: - Built public doctor command with a real synthetic HTTP server, SDK initialization, configured fetch and actual DELETE. Only post-response body cancellation is fault-injected. - Baseline pending cancellation delayed local close by about five seconds and reported uncertain cleanup about ten seconds after cancellation started. Candidate pending cancellation completed cleanup in about seven milliseconds with one DELETE. - Rejecting cancellation, accepted 405, bodyless 204, rejected 500, and failed initialization controls preserved their expected cleanup and command outcomes. - The pending-cancellation regression failed on the original code for the intended stalled termination. All 61 focused transport, fetch, guarded-stream, and selected cleanup tests passed after the fix. Formatting, focused lint, and native commit hooks passed. - Independent source review found no actionable issues. A fresh source-blind validator independently ran all six public cases and passed their runtime clauses. Full raw evidence is retained privately because it includes runtime and session details. This is synthetic dependency-fault proof; it does not claim that every remote server can cause native cancellation to hang. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: 資安業者揭露逾9,300個外洩AWS金鑰仍可用，其中數百個具備企業帳號完整控制權限
items.summary: 資安公司Truffle Security近日發布報告，指出研究人員追蹤與驗證2022年8月至2026年8月間公開洩漏的AWS存取金鑰後，發現超過9,300個至今仍有效，其中還有數百個金鑰擁有企業AWS帳號完整管理權限。研究人員從Git儲存庫、Git歷史紀錄、Hugging Face資料集、Docker映像檔、套件註冊庫及CI日誌等公開來源，找到64,024個AWS金鑰，對應50,654個AWS帳號。

items.title: 銀行迎戰虛擬資產新業務，資安業者共組「穩定幣暨虛擬資產安全聯盟」，協助打造自主可控數位金融安全
items.summary: 隨著全球穩定幣與虛擬資產監管浪潮興起，臺灣《虛擬資產服務法》今年6月三讀通過、7月正式公布，虛擬資產監管制度逐步成形，銀行等金融機構要如何安全接軌虛擬資產業務，也帶動新的資安需求。9月8日，台灣資訊安全協會宣布成立「穩定幣暨虛擬資產安全聯盟」，首波集結中華資安國際、博士旺創新、凱特納科技與普鴻資訊4家業者，從數位金融安全基礎建設所需的不同關鍵能力切入，希望整合臺灣產業能量，逐步打造具國際競爭力的數位金融產業合作模式。
